source_units.text: Explain an exception in a fictional fabrication specification.
Build the piece around these synthetic facts: Panel C may retain a two millimeter gap because it is decorative only.
It bears no load in the fictional model.
All other panels keep the drawn fit; the exception is not a general tolerance change.
The text must contain "Panel C", "a two millimeter gap", "decorative only" verbatim.
Use at least 60 words and no more than 90 words in total.
